name: Cislunar-Quoin
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the monolithic structures of unknown origin left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
There is money in water here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
